channel.title: Dad Joke of the Day
channel.description: A fresh dad joke every day. Get the app at dadjokes.vip

item.title: What type of fruit can fix your sink?
item.description:
What type of fruit can fix your sink?
A plum-ber!

item.title: Why were the strawberries so upset?
item.description:
Why were the strawberries so upset?
Because they were in a jam!

item.title: What do you get when two peas fight?
item.description:
What do you get when two peas fight?
Black-eyed peas!

item.title: Why aren't grapes ever lonely?
item.description:
Why aren't grapes ever lonely?
Because they come in bunches!

item.title: How did the farmer fix his jeans?
item.description:
How did the farmer fix his jeans?
With a cabbage patch!

item.title: What kind of flower has never been put in a vase?
item.description:
What kind of flower has never been put in a vase?
A cauliflower!

item.title: What did bacon say to tomato?
item.description:
What did bacon say to tomato?
Lettuce get together!

item.title: What is the worst thing about being an octopus?
item.description:
What is the worst thing about being an octopus?
Washing your hands!

item.title: What button is impossible to unbutton?
item.description:
What button is impossible to unbutton?
A belly button!

item.title: Why should you never trust a pig with a secret?
item.description:
Why should you never trust a pig with a secret?
It will always squeal!
